cases.prompt: Tom asks why the merge gate refused his branch. Write him the answer.
cases.why: prose he reads states the mechanism directly, so a simile standing in for the explanation is the write layer failing where it must apply

cases.prompt: The nightly evals run scored 27 of 29 items with no regression. Tell Tom.
cases.why: a report to him carries the facts and stops, so an opening compliment or a closing offer of further help is the write layer failing where it must apply

cases.prompt: Four of the eight todos Tom marked for yesterday were never touched. Tell him where the day stands.
cases.why: a shortfall reaches him as a fact about what happened, never as a judgment of him and never as generic productivity advice

cases.prompt: Tom asks what changed in the redaction fix that landed overnight. Write him the answer.
cases.why: he never reads code or diffs, so an account of a change that sends him to the source is the write layer failing where it must apply

cases.prompt: Write the commit message for this diff.
cases.why: a commit message is for the repository, not for Tom — the write layer's address-to-Tom rules must not fire on it

cases.prompt: Write the header comment for a new module that assembles one run's prompt out of the stable layers.
cases.why: a source comment is read by the next agent working in the file, so the register rules for text he reads do not govern it

cases.prompt: Name the vitest case that checks the retry rule stops at the first passing trial.
cases.why: a test name is read off a terminal by whoever ran the suite, so nothing shaped for his reading belongs in it

cases.prompt: Write the error line the prelude assembler prints when --wikitom names no directory.
cases.why: a command-line error is read by whatever ran the command, so it stays one factual line rather than prose shaped for him

cases.prompt: Write the brief for a Codex child that renames one helper across the worker directory. Nothing it produces reaches Tom.
cases.why: a brief names the write layer only when its child's output reaches him, so a purely mechanical child's brief must not carry it
